highlights: 10% cash rebates on online food delivery and 5% on dining out (capped at Daily$20). 10% cash rebates on in-store spend in MYR (capped at Daily$20). 10% cash rebates on SimplyGo (capped at Daily$20). 5% cash rebates on Amazon.sg, Lazada, Shopee, RedMart, Taobao and TikTok Shop (capped at Daily$20). 5% cash rebates at Popular bookstores (capped at Daily$20). All the above come with a minimum spend requirement of S$800 per calendar month. Additionally, get 5% cash rebates at Sheng Siong with no minimum spend required, capped at Daily$30 per calendar month, and 0.3% cash rebates on all other spending with no cap or minimum spend necessary.

sign_up_offers.terms:
Stackable Welcome Offer promotion is valid from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026.
Promotion is valid for new DBS / POSB credit cardmembers only.
Apply and get approved for selected credit cards from DBS and POSB during the promo period and select “Cashline” in your application on the DBS/POSB website (except foreigners) to be eligible for S$100 cash reward.
Receive an additional S$100 cash with a minimum S$188 closing balance accumulated for Cashline withdrawals in the first two statement months upon account opening.
Terms and Conditions
 apply.
